input.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: an original reference portrait for testing a photo-editing product. Generate ONE fictional adult person, not a celebrity or any recognizable real person.
Subject: a woman clearly in her early thirties, short dark-brown hair in a simple modern bob, brown eyes, natural facial proportions with slight asymmetry, a relaxed closed-mouth smile. No makeup retouching or fashion glamour. She wears a plain light gray crew-neck cotton T-shirt.
Scene: plain softly illuminated light-gray indoor wall, uncluttered and without objects. Contemporary neutral digital photography, not vintage and not a stylized illustration.
Composition: portrait 4:5 framing, head and torso visible, front facing with a slight natural turn, both shoulders fully in frame, plenty of space above the head, arms and hands outside the crop. Face well lit, focused, detailed natural skin texture, no harsh shadows.
Constraints: one fictional adult only; no text, dates, marks, logos, watermarks, jewelry, glasses, other people, collage, or frame. This is the neutral ORIGINAL reference photograph; do not apply an eighties aesthetic, film fading or grain yet.
